name: Weighted Average Cost of Capital Calculator
meta_title: WACC Calculator: Weighted Average Cost of Capital
meta_description: Work out a company's weighted average cost of capital from the market values and costs of its equity, debt and preferred stock, with after-tax debt.
h1: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) Calculator
subtitle: Combine the cost of equity, the after-tax cost of debt and any preferred stock, weighted by market value, into one overall cost of capital.

If the debt isn't traded, its book value is a common stand-in. For the cost, use the yield to maturity on the company's bonds or the rate it would pay on new borrowing.

%

The rate at which interest is deductible. The US federal corporate rate is 21%; add state income tax if it applies.

Cost of preferred stock is usually its annual dividend divided by its current price. Preferred dividends aren't tax deductible.

WACC is the minimum average return the company must earn on its investments to satisfy all its lenders and shareholders.

How each source adds up

Each source's contribution is its weight times its cost (after tax for debt). The contributions add up to the WACC.
